lines.t: Morning breaks on a restless heart
Dust on my feet, I wandered far
Chasing shadows, chasing
Looking for truth I've never found Then your voice came soft and near
Living water calmed my fear Not with force, not with flame
Just quiet love that called my name Yahushua, you waited for me
By the river of mercy flowing free
Yahushua, you opened my eyes
To a love that never fades or dies
I held on to what would not last
Ooh, built my hope on a fragile path
Every promise turned to sand
Ooh, slipped right through my open hands
Still you stood where I could fall
Grace unearned you gave it all
You didn't turn, you didn't leave
You stayed right there and I believe
Yahushua, you waited for me
By the river of mercy flowing free
Yahushua, you opened my eyes
To a love that never fades or dies
Your truth moves steady, slow and strong
God ain't lied when I was wrong
Not bound by time, not moved by fear
Your kingdom's closer than it appears
Yahushua, you waited for me
By the river of mercy flowing free
Yahushua, you opened my eyes
I rise to a love that never fades or dies. From the rising sun to evenings. I walk with you, my Savior, my friend. Every breath, every day.
I live in truth, I walk your way
